fields.summary: Aircraft assignment — assign aircraft to flight
fields.description:
As a dispatcher I want to assign an aircraft to a flight so that every scheduled flight has an aircraft allocated.

Acceptance Criteria

  1. The assignment form shows all active aircraft available for the selected flight date.
  2. Selecting an aircraft and saving updates the flight record immediately.
  3. If the aircraft becomes grounded after assignment, a warning is shown on the flight detail page.
  4. The dispatcher can change the aircraft assignment up to 2 hours before the scheduled departure.

Out of Scope

Automated aircraft assignment based on availability algorithms is not in scope for this story.

Technical Constraints

Aircraft availability is determined by the maintenance system API. The response must be received within 3 seconds or the form displays a timeout error.
